name: dsfd_capt_status_x43_t_split1016x
structural_change: DECISION B successor of the dsfd_capt_status_dual hard leaf (split1016: FF hold -81 ps on the intra-leaf ot_ratio_cdc_fifo 1-tick 4:3 arcs, hold repair stalled; split1016b co-located entries, same RTL). The ratio FIFO is replaced by a fixed-phase 3-bank x43 transfer split per clock root (ot_s81_vm_x43 pattern, CLOSED VM x43 leaves): dsfd_capt_status_x43_t (ck) samples f_sn at stream index 0/2/3 into banks b0/b2/b3; dsfd_capt_status_x43_s (ckv) reads them at serial edge 2/0/1 into t_st. Marker moved to stream index 2 so no cross-root arc has a 1-tick window (worst setup 2 ticks = 513 ps). dsfd_capt_status_dual is now a logic-free wrapper. Latency: f_sn on t_st 6/7/8 VCO ticks after stream index 2/3/0 (stream index 1 not sampled); epoch-reset startup contract. T leaf: 192 bank flops + epoch counter/parity/marker; outputs all flops; outhold off (VM x43_t precedent: bank read >= 1 tick after launch, rewritten >= 4 ticks after the fixed read). Seam pins spread at 8 M4 tracks (gate oflop face density); f_sn / t_st moved to the centre of their bit's triplet.

pin_regs.reason: Every output (b0/b2/b3, bpar, t_mark) is a dedicated flop and every data input f_sn lands directly in the bank flops (one phase hold-mux): the banks ARE the pin registers. A generic recipe-3 input/output register would shift the fixed 3:4 sample indices by one stream cycle (unpriced against the epoch schedule and the S leaf's fixed read edges).
